Dead by Daylight has an amazing concept, iconic horror characters, interesting killer abilities, and so much wasted potential.

Unfortunately, the experience for casual-beginers and returning players(after long time) can be absolutely miserable. You just want to enjoy a couple of matches after a long day, but instead you get matched against experienced players who know every map, every perk, and every trick in the book.

The gameplay also gets incredibly repetitive. Repair generators, run, hide, get hooked, repeat.

And here's my biggest complaint: WHY IS THERE STILL NO PROPER SINGLE-PLAYER MODE?

I would happily play hundreds of hours against AI survivors and AI killers with adjustable difficulty, from Easy to Nightmare, proper progression, Bloodpoints, Prestige, and unlockable perks.

I don't want to compete with strangers who spend their lives mastering every single mechanic. I want to enjoy the fantastic horror characters I've paid for, at my own pace.

Yes, custom matches with survivor bots exist. But without proper difficulty settings, progression, rewards, or AI killers, they're no substitute for a real single-player experience.

I want to win sometimes and not everytime play against professional flashlight enthusiasts and unbeatable killers.

Until then, uninstalling. Maybe I'll see you next Halloween.
